title: FEZIBO 40 x 24 Inches Electric Standing Desk Adjustable Height, 3 Memory Height Settings, Sit Stand Up Desk for Home Office & Computer Workstation, Maple

reviews.title: FEZIBO 48 x 24 Inches Electric Standing Desk
reviews.body: Easy to put together. I did it by myself a 68 yo old lady. It doesn’t have a riser or a pull out drawer like a couple of the reviews mentioned. I reported those reviews because they are not for this desk. The desk moves up and down smoothly. I wish it was bigger. My laptop and monitor fit nicely but with the printer there isn’t enough room to have a place for the thing that holds my mail. The desk top comes in two pieces that have to be screwed together. I would have preferred it in one piece. But overall for the price I’m happy with it.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on June 27, 2026
reviews.author: Laura R.

reviews.title: If I can assemble it then anyone can!
reviews.body: I’m not a fan of assembling furniture on my own. I usually recruit my husband for such tasks but I was mad at him and decided to take a stab at it myself (we’ve all been there, right?). Thankfully there isn’t a ton of assembly involved and it was easy to figure out what went where and screw everything into place. It didn’t take me long at all to fully assemble and if I can do it then anyone can.As for the stand itself, I’m pleasantly surprised with how sleek and sturdy it is. It looks great in my office and I immediately noticed my improved posture now that I can use my laptop at the right height. I imagine that this will help with the back aches that I’ve been experiencing from hunching over all day. The stand is easy to raise and there’s some power to it there so be prepared to offer some counter resistance. I do have to lean in and put some weight onto the stand to lower it. I like that you can lock it at any height that you want, as I’ve had other stands in the past with only one height option for standing. My other home office equipment hasn’t arrived yet (an additional monitor and wireless keyboard) but I feel optimistic that this stand will be able to support a second screen in addition to my laptop. It seems like a great product for the price!
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on March 30, 2022
reviews.author: Jen S.

reviews.title: Takes muscle to push down. Very nice stand.
reviews.body: Those are 22 in computer screens. Very sturdy stand. Can put weight on it. Takes muscle to push town though, actually need to press it down. Not a problem though, just not like other stands that glide down on their own.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on October 14, 2022
reviews.author: C.R.E.A.M.

reviews.title: Great value!
reviews.body: If you plan on putting two large monitors on this go bigger. We have a large monitor and a laptop and it’s just enough room. Great so far and seems to be made well and not cheaply. I highly recommend this product for in home work area.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on February 16, 2022
reviews.author: Sean Mask

reviews.title: Shelf design only flaw
reviews.body: I needed a compact riser for a small space I wanted to turn into a standing station. This one is exactly as described and I find the product to be sturdy and the hydraulic riser to work really well. My only complaint is that the lower shelf for the keyboard comes out quite far and can’t be moved in/out, but you can also completely remove this piece and use the riser without it. I personally find it challenging to stand comfortably with this small shelf attached.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on June 16, 2021
reviews.author: Katelynn Perrault

reviews.title: great product but FYI the middle tray sticks out
reviews.body: smooth and stable rising. def great for WFH in small space environment (NYC here) just a heads up if youre limited on space, just be aware the middle tray sticks out, you can remove it and only use top platform if you need though.

features: Flexible Height Adjustment Range: Easily switch between sitting and standing with a height range of 28.3" to 46.5", offering a comfortable fit for different heights and working postures
Designed for Any Space: The 40" x 24" small standing desk is compact and easy to move. Ideal for home offices, bedrooms, dorms, study spaces and creative studios

One-Touch Height Adjustment: Featuring 3 programmable presets, the intelligent control panel lets you switch to your ideal sitting or standing height with a single touch — no more tedious manual adjustments

Outstanding Reliability: Built with high-quality steel frame and FSC-certified spliced desktop, this adjustable desk delivers exceptional stability and long-lasting durability, tested to withstand over 50,000 lift cycles at full load
Quick & Easy Assembly: Most components come pre-assembled to simplify setup, and with a detailed instruction manual and video guide, you can have your desk ready in just 30 minutes
